description: Download a Runway output (video, image, audio) to a local file. Use after a task succeeds to save the output locally. output_path MUST live inside RUNWAY_DOWNLOAD_ROOT (default ~/Downloads/runway-mcp). Sensitive paths (~/.ssh, ~/.aws, /etc, ~/.bashrc, ~/.zshrc) are refused even when the root would otherwise permit them. By default, refuses to overwrite an existing file (atomic flags: "wx") — pass overwrite: true to clobber.

output_path.description: Local file path to save to. Must be inside RUNWAY_DOWNLOAD_ROOT (default ~/Downloads/runway-mcp). Parent directory must exist.

overwrite.description: If true, replace an existing file at output_path. Defaults to false (refuses to clobber).

url.description: Output URL from a completed task.

name: download_runway_output
